scene1.line: The future of artificial intelligence does not belong to electricity alone.

scene2.description: Two qubits linked across space, their states correlated beyond what classical bits allow.

scene3.description: Information carried on light itself, moving at the speed the universe allows.

scene4.description: Computation that treats heat and noise as a resource, not a flaw to eliminate.

scene5.statement: QPT — the first language model to combine the best of three types of computing to achieve greater efficiency and lower cost.

scene7.final: QPT exists to answer a single research question honestly: Which parts of a language model actually benefit from non-classical computing, and by how much?

scene8.suffix: will also play an important role in this process.
